notes.title: 2nd Anniversary of Forward to the Sky!
notes.content:
Hello community, thank you all so much for your support of Forward to the Sky. As result of your support we are able to continue making games, and we hope we will be able to make another great game soon. To  celebrate the 2nd Anniversary we are going to run a week-long sale starting from January 30th.

Thank you for playing the game. We hope you like it. :)

notes.title: Forward to The Sky Now on Sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I am glad to announce to you all that Forward to The Sky is now on sale for it's very first time! Now you'll be able to buy it much cheaper than it normally was being sold for. But it's only temporary! So make sure you hurry up and buy some now before it goes off sale! If you have anything you want to say, report, or ask us about, visit our Hub Forums and tell us what's on your mind! I am the Hub Administrator. So please do ask any questions you have! Have a wonderful day!
